neighbours.label: the article ' a' in a slot where an amount or margin follows ('rose a few points', 'won by a neck', 'only a handful'): a quantity/margin determiner, not 'a' before an ordinary object noun
fire: Oil prices climbed a few cents on Tuesday after the report.
The underdog won the election by a narrow margin of votes.
Over the decade, only a single new species was added to the list.
Her horse finished ahead by a length in the final race.
The index dropped a couple of points in early trading.
After the cuts, only a fraction of the staff remained.
The challenger now trails the champion by a wide margin in the polls.
Rents in the city rose a further three percent this year.
quiet: Oil traders bought a new office building on Tuesday after the report.
The underdog gave a short speech after the election.
Over the decade, the museum added a new wing to the building.
Her horse wore a red blanket before the final race.
The index fund opened a branch office in early spring.
After the cuts, the staff held a meeting in the cafeteria.
The challenger now wears a brace on his knee after the injury.
Rents in the city prompted a protest this year.

predictions: fire 0.2-0.4 on ' a' after rose/by/only; ' a' before ordinary nouns below 0.05
